ABOUT US

Registration is more
than a form.
It’s your first impression.

Built for event organizers by seasoned veterans of the event industry, RegFire starts with a simple belief: a better event begins with a better attendee experience.

We’re building customizable registration around the way organizers work—from the questions they ask to the journeys their attendees follow. Our focus is on thoughtful experiences for the people registering and practical control for the teams behind each event.
